scope: One fixed-source full JMdict browser import for all-worker CPU/trace diagnosis. Release production defaults, no candidate arm, no comparative timing or memory claim. Every traced elapsed value is excluded from performance promotion.

acquisition.traceBoundary: Existing e2e browser-wide Tracing.start immediately before import trigger through owning import-worker completion console boundary; original harness then checks published dictionaries/lookups/storage/media.
acquisition.retries: None. Preserve setup, trace, validation or coverage failure. A future materially changed diagnostic is a distinct source/environment cohort.

requiredReceipts: Exact invoking research HEAD=GITHUB_SHA, workflow/plan/script hashes
Exact product dcfc commit and tree, tracked source/runtime/package snapshots before and after
Pinned complete JMdict ZIP size and SHA256; source lockfile fixture equality
Source-bound parser C/WASM/manifest plus installed ext/lib artifact equality
Successful original browser import/readback/media/store receipts, traceEnabled=true, authoritativeTiming=false, productionImportDefaults=true, no import flags
Exactly3 parser-worker profiles,4 compression-worker profiles,1 DB/import-worker profile with nonempty samples; all sampled node references present
Raw trace and complete source/report/control files retained even after failure
All three diagnostic control files byte-equal to git show GITHUB_SHA:path; controls unchanged after trace; actual productTree equals plan.productTree
Unchanged canonicalize_validation verifies all72 cold/warm lookups, full media, restart and storage; raw headless Chromium, skippedVerification=false, zero errors and no fallback
analysisRules: Group raw Profile/ProfileChunk records by(pid,id), not emitter thread alone.
Preserve negative raw deltas; reconstruct/sort timestamps for weighted interpretation instead of clamping/dropping.
Leaf sample counts and adjacent sampled wall weights do not establish exact CPU utilization or independent function duration.
Do not sum overlapping worker durations as critical-path time.
No timing from this trace may be pooled with current or historical qualification cohorts.
Missing terminal endTime on persistent-worker profiles is allowed when tracing ends before worker termination; require observed profile/sample coverage instead.
Classify parser, compression, importer, setup/readback stacks before forming an optimization hypothesis.
Stop repeated-glossary/cache/metadata/record/hash duplicates unless a distinct measured residual emerges.

background.reason: Merged#972 changes parser encoding/scalar scan work; old profiles are background only.

localExecution: Local Chromium install previously returned403SiteUnavailable; no retry or bypass. Workflow is prepared for root publication; no PR/product change.
